it is `issued` (held back from the shelf) without the story ever
A Ferengi holosuite house's programme reel, dubbed off a display
loop by somebody on the Adirondack's off watch. The joke is the
sales pitch: every programme is described, none is shown, and the
fine print is longer than the reel. Keep it clean: the titles
suggest, the tape never delivers, and the catalogue is the comedy.
Era: a house that has been trading on the same programmes for two
generations, which the host is proud of. No named canon character
speaks; the house is not Quark's, it only wishes it were.
title: Holosuite programme reel (dubbed off a display loop)
subtitle: A Ferengi pleasure house's catalogue, pirated
author: house recording; copied by persons unknown
extra: Nineteen minutes of sales pitch. No programme is ever shown.

lines.text: WELCOME TO THE HOUSE OF THE SEVENTEENTH RULE
PROGRAMME SELECTION. ALL SALES ARE FINAL.
Welcome, valued customer. Your holosuite is ready.
Tonight's selection, beginning with our bestseller.
VULCAN LOVE SLAVE, PART ONE
A timeless story. We have run it for sixty years.
The reel shows the title card and nothing else.
VULCAN LOVE SLAVE, PART TWO: THE REVENGE
Also a timeless story. Also sixty years.
Skip it. Skip it. Somebody's coming down the tube.
Nobody skips it. The reel does not have a skip.
THE BATTLE OF TONG VEY (KLINGON HISTORICAL)
Bat'leths provided. Injuries at the guest's expense.
A 1962 LAS VEGAS LOUNGE (VERY POPULAR WITH HUMANS)
I don't understand it either. They keep booking it.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Rule of Acquisition number two hundred and three.
New customers are like razor-toothed gree-worms.
Surcharges apply to safeties, lighting and plot.
Tipping the holographic staff is compulsory.
The fine print scrolls. It keeps scrolling.
How is this the best thing on the whole ship.
Thank you for choosing us. Please do not tell Quark.
END OF REEL. PLEASE INSERT LATINUM.
